# runtime.yml's jobs (docs/develop/ci.md, "Gates"): which ids of .github/ci/paths.txt run each, its role, and when the
# `Runtime gate` may see it skipped (.github/ci/runtime-skips.sh; .github/ci/gate-needs.sh --check holds the workflow to
# this table). A row: the job id, its rt ids (comma-separated; - for none: it always runs), its role and its skip-when
# tokens.
#   build     compiles, and saves its cache; it runs on main's push (the cache run)
#   consumer  runs what a build job made: it needs that job, its if: begins with ${{ !cancelled(), so it runs and fails
#             when the build failed, and main's push skips it
#   check     anything else (its own toolchain or target, a policy)
# Tokens: pr (a pull request), cache-run (a push to main), schedule (the daily run), dispatch-only:ID (only a manual run
# that names ID). A new job comes with its row, in the same commit.
images             rt-linux       build     schedule
linux              rt-linux       build     schedule
msrv               rt-msrv        check     schedule
escape-host        rt-escape      build     schedule
debug-live         rt-linux       build     schedule
agent-containers   rt-containers  build     schedule
fleet              rt-fleet       check     dispatch-only:rt-fleet
android            rt-android     check     schedule
deny               rt-deny        check
fuzz-build         rt-fuzz        build     pr
fuzz               rt-fuzz        consumer  pr cache-run
macos              rt-macos       build     schedule
macos-conformance  rt-macos       build     schedule
macos-perf         rt-macos       build     schedule
gate               -              check
